They are not unrelated concerns. Both belong to the same outer-layer boundary: concrete implementations and runtime bootstrapping.

It hands app creation to the module's own composition abstraction (createApp from ./composition/AppFactory), so it does not bypass that abstraction. AppFactory is the file that imports UuidIdGenerator, so the wiring stays in one place.

Neither file repeats a rule or invariant. ID generation lives only in UuidIdGenerator, and the port and listen settings live only in server.ts. The unit is small, but it is consistent with the module's boundary.
